title: We didn’t plan to spend our last day in Manila like this but ended up being one of our favourites..
description:
POV: We didn’t plan to spend our last day in Manila like this… but it ended up being one of our favorite memories. 🇵🇭🙏

Family travel rarely goes exactly how you planned.

Especially on the last day.

After spending three beautiful weeks in the Philippines with the kids (plus a quick side trip to Japan), it was finally time for us to fly back to Sydney.

And of course…

On our last day, the rain decided to arrive.

Not a little drizzle.

I mean full day rain. The kind that makes you cancel every outdoor plan.

Our home in Manila sits right across Roxas Boulevard, so naturally we thought…

Well… where do Filipinos go when it rains?

The mall. 😅

Luckily we’re only 5 minutes from Mall of Asia and 2 minutes from Ayala Malls, so we embraced it.

No sightseeing.

No big itinerary.

Just a slow, random day.

We did a few bank errands.
A relaxed lunch.
Some salon pampering for Mommy Belle… and yes Daddy Barry joined too. 😂

The kids wandered around toy stores and snack stalls like it was an adventure.

And by evening, we met up with relatives for a farewell dinner at a lovely Chinese restaurant.

Nothing fancy.

Just family.
Stories.
Laughter.

And suddenly the rainy day didn’t feel like a ruined plan.

It felt like the perfect ending.

Because here’s something family travel has taught us again and again:

Not every day needs to be packed with attractions.

Sometimes the best travel memories happen on the slow days.

The unexpected days.

The “let’s just see what happens today” kind of days.

Those quiet moments are where the real connection happens.

Kids relax.
Parents breathe.
And the trip feels like a family story instead of a checklist.

So if your next family vacation doesn’t go exactly as planned…

Take a deep breath.

Slow down.

Let the day unfold.

Sometimes the unplanned days become the ones you remember the most. ❤️

Now I’m curious…

Have you ever had a travel day that went completely off plan but still turned out beautiful?

Tell me your story in the comments 👇

Comment FAMILY and we’ll invite you to join our family travel community where parents share tips, stories, and inspiration for traveling with kids. ✈️💛
